profile_host.py.scope: Model-independent measured Host trace analysis; no extrapolation

host_profile_report.py.scope: Model-independent measured Host trace analysis; no extrapolation

portability_changes: Example capture paths remain repository-relative placeholders; the method2 reference path resolves to the bundled data/communication-reference.csv.
Regression fixtures use the synthetic communication table; the original historical input is archived separately under data/.
Tests requiring private capture fixtures are skipped when those fixtures are absent.
The original machine-specific test import fallback was removed.
Regression tests were grouped under tests/ and optional standalone checks under tools/; runtime scripts and presentation assets are unchanged.

SWA and U diagnostic drill-downs add evidence only; original source/target cycle, TPOT and rank-selection formulas are unchanged. Repository iterations use branches and pull requests with offline regression checks.

Main CSA/HCA and draft SWA retain per-layer ten-stage evidence; both method sheets display five independent source-stage tables and native editable horizontal charts after the U composition. Core estimates and rank selection are unchanged; legacy SWA outputs remain available.

Independent trace-only Host analysis accepts main-only models without HC or draft assumptions. It reports validated same-track inclusive/self wall, runtime and queue evidence, per-device task coverage, conservative source links and bounded-detail HTML/CSV/JSON/XLSX; model and hardware declarations remain unverified without customer captures.
